For Explanation:
*  If yes, please briefly describe the governance structure and its operating model
Provide updated explanation (if applicab: On the national level, the Ministry of the Interior is responsible for open data policies and practices, but they work together with all the departments, implementing organisations, provinces, municipalities, and the water boards. For example on the creation of the national data strategy (IBDS) and its implementation, the governance structure has been described here on page 25: https://realisatieibds.nl/file/download/1c9729a6-70a9-4bda-a245-49c1d6d63adb/meerjarenaanpak-interbestuurlijke-datastrategie6maart2023.pdf ; there is OBDO: Overheidsbreed Beleidsoverleg Digitale Overheid 'intergovernmental policy committee for digital administration. OBDO is an advisory board for digital policy and ICT use within the public sector, with representatives from all layers of government. And IDO: Interbestuurlijk Data Overleg, intergovernmental data committee, mandated by OBDO to determine the strategy for government data policy and (inter)governmental data related programs (such as IBDS, the intergovernmental data strategy), for which it sets the scope and direction. And there is a focusgroup working on the implementation.
